methods.original: Exact original full gradient; repeat seeds1/2 quantifies numerical trajectory variation against the previous screen.
methods.target-stop: Detach only future means in transition rate; past encoder is trained to predict the current online target.
methods.input-stop: Detach only noisy past states in transition rate; future encoder is trained to follow the prior.
methods.rate-stop: Detach both transition inputs and targets; prior fits RGB-grounded codes while encoder keeps FM and entry gradients.
methods.render-stop: Negative control: detach renderer conditions; remove RGB grounding gradients from the encoder while preserving its rate gradients.

protocol.basis: First frontier screen completed120exits0 with no consistent paired planning improvement; distinguish encoder/prior coupling using forward-identical controls.
protocol.scope: Existing mature models, short adaptation only. All candidates remain sample-level, no cross-sample statistics, EMA or additional parameters. stop-gradient update rules are not the original full-gradient KL objective.
protocol.gate: Stop all20training at600extra updates; review finite weights, posterior/interventions, paired P0 before any continuation. render-stop is a negative control, not a promoted method.

references.title: SimSiam: stop-gradient without a momentum encoder
references.scope: Known optimization principle, not claimed invented or proven suitable for this model.

limitations: 600update adaptation from an existing2epochcheckpoint; not from-scratch training or a stability result.
Four existing mature training seeds; final claims need independent from-scratch training and unused evaluation cases.
P0twoevalseeds,16CFcases and64generationclips are a screen, not the full original benchmark.
Bootstrap intervals condition on these fixed weights and episode clusters; not uncertainty across training seeds.
Candidate/control comparisons are exploratory with no multiple-testing correction; selected wins require independent confirmation.
Forward values match the original rate/FM; semigradient routing is not full-gradient original KL optimization.
Same parameter/update count is not equal compute; report per-arm training time and extra model calls.
Future states only enter training targets within the same video; no futureRGB is passed to inference.
